Change has become a way of life for many companies. But is change the way to keep pace with change? The exact opposite appears to be true. The landscape is littered with the debris of projects that companies rushed into in attempting to keep pace. Singer trying to move into the boom in home appliances. RCA moving into the boom in computers. General Foods moving into the boom in fastfood outlets. Not to mention the hundreds of companies that threw away their corporate identities to chase the passing fad to initials.
